title: Agent architectural review and ground-up rebuild

completion_criteria.text: Current-state audit complete: every gap in the roster, the agent definitions and the observation machinery identified with measured evidence from the ledger and the definition files.
Audit delivered in a form the user can read and navigate - a self-contained HTML explainer with diagrams, written for a reader with no prior domain knowledge.
Target architecture designed and approved by the user: roster shape, tool grants, who may delegate, and how the configuration observes itself.
Instruction-layer correctness fixes shipped ahead of the rebuild: two dead agent references repointed, StructuredOutput granted to all 15 agents, and the unenforceable confirmation claim deleted.
Agent and observer teardown and rebuild executed without breaking the live coupling surface: rules and skills naming agents by string, 18 worktrees carrying roster copies, derived residuals.
New configuration verified in real use: dispatch routes to the intended agents, and the observation system attributes every run and records an outcome.

spine.active_goal: Ship SPEC wave 3 as one stacked human-merged pull request per unit, after merging the three open wave 1 and wave 2 pull requests.
spine.next_step: Three PRs open, all green, all based on main, worktrees freed: 191 (U1.2 census, completes wave 1), 190 (U2.1 platform-engineer skill), 189 (U2.2 conformance-auditor skill). Merge in THAT order, so the census is live before it validates the two new skills. U3.1 is still building on feat/observer-write-path; U3.2 to U3.4 stack on it per decision 0521 - never merge a child until its parent branch is deleted and confirmed gone.
spine.last_session: Shipped wave 1's missing unit and all of wave 2 by parallel Opus dispatch: PRs 191, 190 and 189, every check green. Decided the observer record contract as decision 0524 - ten fields not 22, with parent and depth from a platform sidecar. U3.1 in flight.

open_risks.text: Never read `emitter` in the events log as a measurement — it is a hardcoded constant on every row, and treating it as signal already produced one wrong conclusion
Prefer the logbook-inline ledger store — the sibling logbook-logbook store is missing decisions, so the wrong path returns a plausible near-complete answer instead of an obvious nothing
Branch worktree-agent-a7014b3f8b04d580d is NOT merged into main and predates this session — it was deliberately held back during cleanup and needs a disposition before it is assumed disposable

Superseding thread agent-roster-gap-resolution is BLOCKED by a schema defect, not merely pending — two malformed decision refs make transition_thread and archive_thread both refuse, so no tool can close it

The b6 spec asserts a hook that no longer exists — protect-claude-config.sh was deleted in c8a1b9a7, so this is a SECOND removed control in the self-modification domain and belongs to the thread already open on that exposure

Run the preserved validator before AND after any edit to the round-4 report — its ratified baseline is exactly two failing checks, so a third means that session introduced a regression rather than hitting a known one

Never merge a stacked child before its parent branch is deleted and confirmed gone with git ls-remote — GitHub retargets a child onto main only on base deletion, so merging early makes it merge into a dead branch, report MERGED, and never reach main
refs: PR 162 was closed and reopened as 167 over exactly this

open_risks.text: U3.4 would silently destroy decision 0493's work — the old observer is the only emitter of capability_blocked and the ten-field record has no home for it, so the new log needs its own event type before the cutover
refs: filed as a background task chip

open_risks.text: The SPEC contradicts itself on the engine boundary — section 5a blocks wave 3 and later on the engine, while the section 6 table gates only wave 4 and says waves 0 to 3 may proceed now; two statements to one favour wave 4, but this needs a ruling

Do not trust this thread's own wave-completion claims without checking the deliverable on disk — the ledger asserted wave 1 was fully built while U1.2 had no implementation at all, and three merged PRs made the claim look corroborated

Merge origin/main into every branch before opening its pull request — the receipts G11 gate diffs the current main tip against the head, so files main gained after the branch point read as deletions and it blocks naming files the branch never touched

U3.4 has a component no pull request can deliver — the observer's hook is registered in two settings files and the global one is a real file outside version control, so retiring the old observer needs a hand edit there

Re-check the waves 4 to 7 gate rather than assuming it still blocks — engine PRs 172 to 187 are now all on main by ancestry, but the engine thread stands at 11 of 15 and its own spine records it failed its stated goal

The drift check U1.3 shipped never runs against this machine's real plugin manifest — CI has no plugins installed so every test is hermetic, which proves the mechanism but would still let a real plugin upgrade break pointers silently
refs: needed before wave 4 puts real pointers in real bodies

open_risks.text: R13 applies to the Lead band only and its mitigation is detection, not prevention — a Lead can finish work without reading the procedure its duty names, and that only becomes visible once U3.3 lands

Read decisions 0500, 0501 and 0503 together before citing any other record — three records repeat a disproven statistic, 0488 pins five schema-capable agents as seven, and 0503 supersedes 0501's preload assignments

key_decisions.title: The audit pass characterises the current state and recommends nothing
Replace all 56 agents with 13 in four bands, with the dispatch tool held only by the Opus leads
Terminate review loops by closing the reviewer's question, not by capping rounds or turns
Rebuild the observer to append one line per run and do everything else at audit time
Put load-bearing rules in agent bodies, generated from shared fragments with a drift check
User rulings on the six open rebuild questions, and the addition of the observer to this thread
Always reproduce a bug before diagnosing it, and test the fix for cause rather than effect
Skills reach agents only by preload, and the dispatch tool goes to Leads only
Withdraw the report skill and put the answer-format standard in every agent body
Keep the code-reviewer agent, adopt receiving-code-review, drop requesting-code-review
security-reviewer uses neither /security-review nor claude-security
Keep release-engineer broad; the real problem is per-duty procedure loading
The zero-compliance measurement was an instrumentation artifact; re-ground the channel thesis on documentation
The report artifact is outside repo scope, so its codename and CDN findings are ratified, not defects
Read the capability marker from the subagent's own output; scanning the parent transcript over-counts 52x
Delete the destructive-operation confirmation rule; the deny list is the whole control
Drop model and effort from the observer record; the payload never carries them
Re-ground the decision set: preload confirmed, three citations stale, two records narrate unexecuted state
The approved target architecture: 13 agents in four bands, with dispatch and skill invocation held by the Leads
Preload only skills at or under 4KB; larger procedures become body-carried pointers resolved at generation time
Claude in Chrome reproduces; the re-runnable artifact is the investigator's obligation, not the tool's
Update plugins first then clean; reclaim 110 MB and accept 27 MB pinned by a dead worktree
Execute waves 0 through 3 next session; hold waves 4 through 7 until the mitosis engine lands
Strike the unidentifiable backup profiles from c4, and correct the stale worktree count in the same clause
Execute waves 0 to 3 by direct per-unit dispatch, not through the mitosis skill
Cost and permission_denials are unreachable from hooks, so the prose is wrong and they are not fields
Resolve the canonical roster by requiring two independent derivations to agree, and halt when they do not
Parameterise the canonical resolver by subpath, and never canonicalise one side of a comparison
Repoint the continuity ledger rule fully rather than only fixing the two names that dangle
Stack pull requests for blocked MSP chains, with mandatory parent-branch deletion before each child merge
The observer record is ten fields, with parent, depth and agent type read from the platform sidecar

out_of_scope: Cutting the standing instruction load for volume alone - the question is re-scoping with path globs, and the binary trace confirmed rules are the eager per-dispatch cost while skills are lazy.
Migrating the retired project-local agents' domain knowledge into skills and rules - the report places this as a SEPARATE task after the agent and observer rework, not inside it.
